friendswine.config.compressionPercent.to: 0–90, default 50. Feet stay fixed; models and all three camera views share this amplitude while tipsy. Local display only.
friendswine.config.widthPercent.tooltip: 0–200, default 50. Extra width at maximum squash; depth is unchanged. Local display only.
friendswine.config.orbitSpeed.tooltip: 0–4, default 1. 1 = about 20 seconds per turn, 2 = about 10 seconds, 0 pauses orbit. Server-controlled; changes apply after saving. Music, squash and model rotation are unchanged.
friendswine.config.rotationSpeed.tooltip: 0–4, default 1. Zero disables rotation. Full doll mode only; music speed and squash frequency are unchanged.
friendswine.configuration.title: Friends' Wine Settings
friendswine.config.kasumiMinScale.toolti: 0.5–20, default 0.75. Cannot exceed Kasumi's maximum. Local display only; pulses to doll music without changing the hitbox.
friendswine.config.kasumiMaxScale.toolti: 0.5–20, default 1.25. Cannot be below Kasumi's minimum. Local display only; reversed ranges reset to defaults.
friendswine.config.emmaMinScale.tooltip: 0.5–20, default 0.75. Cannot exceed Emma's maximum. Local display only; pulses to doll music without changing the hitbox.
friendswine.config.emmaMaxScale.tooltip: 0.5–20, default 1.25. Cannot be below Emma's minimum. Local display only; reversed ranges reset to defaults.
